page.content:
1980s cartoon that opened with 'Yo Joe!' and sold the vehicles on Saturday mornings.

How G.I. Joe (Sunbow series) connects

  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — The Sunbow series adapts A Real American Hero for television.
  • Concept: Yo Joe! — The Sunbow series made Yo Joe! the team's on-screen battle cry.
  • Character: Duke — Duke is the on-screen field leader of the Sunbow G.I. Joe series.

What is G.I. Joe (Sunbow series)?

The Sunbow G.I. Joe cartoon adapted A Real American Hero for television, with Duke in command on screen, Cobra Commander scheming, and a laser-heavy war that still quotes the toy bios.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero, Yo Joe! and Duke.
